mapper.sql: U.USER_SN, U.EML_ADDR, U.USER_NM, U.ACNT_STTS, U.MBL_TELNO, U.REG_DT, D.DEPT_NM, D.JBPS_NM, D.MFA_USE_YN
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO OPERATOR_DTL_INFO (USER_SN, DEPT_NM, JBPS_NM, MFA_USE_YN, REG_DT, MDFCN_DT, RGTR_SN) VALUES (#{userSn}, #{deptNm}, #{jbpsNm}, 'N', UTC_TIMESTAMP(6), UTC_TIMESTAMP(6), #{userSn})
mapper.select: SELECT FROM USER_ACNT U LEFT JOIN OPERATOR_DTL_INFO D ON D.USER_SN = U.USER_SN AND D.DEL_YN = 'N' WHERE U.USER_SN = #{userSn} AND U.USER_TYPE_CD = 'OPERATOR' AND U.DEL_YN = 'N'
SELECT U.USER_SN, U.EML_ADDR, U.USER_NM, U.ACNT_STTS, U.REG_DT FROM USER_ACNT U WHERE U.USER_SN = #{userSn} AND U.USER_TYPE_CD = 'OPERATOR' AND U.DEL_YN = 'N' FOR UPDATE
SELECT R.ROLE_CD FROM USER_ROLE UR JOIN ROLE_MST R ON R.ROLE_SN = UR.ROLE_SN AND R.DEL_YN = 'N' AND R.USE_YN = 'Y' WHERE UR.ACTV_USER_SN = #{userSn}
SELECT ROLE_SN FROM ROLE_MST WHERE ROLE_CD = #{roleCd} AND USE_YN = 'Y' AND DEL_YN = 'N'
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO USER_ROLE (USER_SN, ROLE_SN, REG_DT, MDFCN_DT, RGTR_SN) SELECT #{userSn}, #{roleSn}, UTC_TIMESTAMP(6), UTC_TIMESTAMP(6), #{userSn} FROM DUAL WHERE NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM USER_ROLE UR WHERE UR.ACTV_USER_SN = #{userSn} AND UR.ACTV_ROLE_SN = #{roleSn})
mapper.select: SELECT U.USER_SN FROM USER_ACNT U WHERE U.USER_TYPE_CD = 'OPERATOR' AND U.ACNT_STTS = 'ACTIVE' AND U.DEL_YN = 'N' AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM USER_ROLE UR JOIN ROLE_MST R ON R.ROLE_SN = UR.ROLE_SN AND R.DEL_YN = 'N' AND R.USE_YN = 'Y' WHERE UR.ACTV_USER_SN = U.USER_SN AND R.ROLE_CD = 'OPERATOR_SUPERVISOR') FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE USER_ACNT SET ACNT_STTS = 'PENDING', ENPSWD = NULL, MDFCN_DT = UTC_TIMESTAMP(6), MDFR_SN = #{mdfrSn} WHERE USER_SN = #{userSn} AND USER_TYPE_CD = 'OPERATOR' AND ACNT_STTS IN ('ACTIVE', 'PENDING') AND DEL_YN = 'N'

UPDATE USER_ACNT SET ENPSWD = #{enpswd}, ACNT_STTS = 'ACTIVE', MDFCN_DT = UTC_TIMESTAMP(6), MDFR_SN = #{userSn} WHERE USER_SN = #{userSn} AND USER_TYPE_CD = 'OPERATOR' AND ACNT_STTS = 'PENDING' AND DEL_YN = 'N'

UPDATE USER_ACNT SET MBL_TELNO = #{mblTelno,typeHandler=egovframework.eeum.base.crypto.MblTelnoEncryptedTypeHandler}, MBL_TELNO_HASH = #{mblTelnoHash}, MDFCN_DT = UTC_TIMESTAMP(6), MDFR_SN = #{mdfrSn} WHERE USER_SN = #{userSn} AND USER_TYPE_CD = 'OPERATOR' AND DEL_YN = 'N'
